en.NAME: FORM API BASE URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Absolute https origin of the Core deployment, for example https://dev-1.servicewand.com. Any other scheme is discarded and the form reports that it could not load.

en.NAME: FORM TYPE CODE
en.DESCRIPTION: Published Core form type code, for example GET_QUOTE_. The document renders whatever that type declares.

en.NAME: FORM ORGANIZATION ID
en.DESCRIPTION: Numeric organization id the submission belongs to. While it is empty the submit button stays disabled and nothing can be posted.

en.NAME: FORM LOCALE
en.DESCRIPTION: Locale segment used when reading the schema and when picking labels out of each nls bag.

en.NAME: FORM THEME
en.DESCRIPTION: Vertical palette. One of: hvac, snow, lawn, pool, roofing, pest, health, beauty. Any other value falls back to snow.

en.NAME: FORM MODE
en.DESCRIPTION: Colour mode. One of: light, dark. Any other value falls back to light.

en.NAME: FORM MAPS API KEY
en.DESCRIPTION: Google Maps browser key, used only by address fields: attributes whose Input format declares address and attributes of class Address. It is visible in page source, as every browser key is, so restrict it by HTTP referrer to this host and to the Maps JavaScript, Places and Geocoding APIs. While it is empty no Google script is loaded and an address field stays a plain text input.

en.NAME: FORM WEBSITE URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Absolute http or https address of the website the success screen's SUCCESS_BACK_LABEL button leads to, for example https://snowlimitless.com. While it is empty, or holds anything else, the success screen shows no such button.

en.NAME: SUCCESS TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Heading of the success screen. Focus moves to it when the submission is accepted.

en.NAME: SUCCESS BODY
en.DESCRIPTION: Sentence under the success heading.

value.en: We’ve received your request and our team will review the property details and prepare your quote.

en.NAME: SUCCESS SENT TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: First line of the green banner on the success screen. {email} is the email address the visitor submitted; the line is shown only when the form held one. Promise a confirmation only while the form type's workflow really emails the requester.

value.en: A confirmation has been sent to {email}.

en.NAME: SUCCESS SENT BODY
en.DESCRIPTION: Second line of the green banner on the success screen, shown with or without an email address. Leave empty, together with an absent email, to show no banner.

value.en: No action is needed from you right now. We’ll contact you if we need any additional information.

en.NAME: SUCCESS SUMMARY TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Heading of the summary card on the success screen. The form id Core returns for the submission is shown beside it as #<id>.

en.NAME: SUCCESS PROPERTIES LABEL
en.DESCRIPTION: Summary row label for the submitted addresses. The row is shown only when the form held at least one address.

en.NAME: SUCCESS PROPERTIES ONE
en.DESCRIPTION: Summary line for exactly one submitted address. {n} is the count.

en.NAME: SUCCESS PROPERTIES MANY
en.DESCRIPTION: Summary line for more than one submitted address. {n} is the count.

en.NAME: SUCCESS MORE LABEL
en.DESCRIPTION: Button under the first two addresses in the summary that shows the rest. {n} is the number of addresses not yet shown.

en.NAME: SUCCESS LESS LABEL
en.DESCRIPTION: Button that folds the summary back to its first two addresses.

en.NAME: SUCCESS CONTACT LABEL
en.DESCRIPTION: Summary row label for the submitted FIRST_NAME and LAST_NAME. The row is shown only when either was given.

en.NAME: SUCCESS EMAIL LABEL
en.DESCRIPTION: Summary row label for the submitted email address. The row is shown only when the form held one.

en.NAME: SUCCESS SUBMITTED LABEL
en.DESCRIPTION: Summary row label for the time the submission was accepted.

en.NAME: SUCCESS SUBMITTED AT
en.DESCRIPTION: Format of the submission time in the visitor's own time zone. {date}, {time} and {zone} are formatted for the form locale, for example Oct 6, 2026, 2:14 PM and PST.

en.NAME: SUCCESS NEXT TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Heading of the next steps on the success screen. It is shown only while at least one SUCCESS_STEP parameter has text.

en.NAME: SUCCESS STEP 1 TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Title of the first next step on the success screen, drawn with a document icon. Promise only what really follows a submission of this form type. Leave both step 1 parameters empty to omit the step.

en.NAME: SUCCESS STEP 1 TEXT
en.DESCRIPTION: Description of the first next step.

value.en: We review your property details and service requirements.

en.NAME: SUCCESS STEP 2 TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Title of the second next step, drawn with a price tag icon. Leave both step 2 parameters empty to omit the step.

en.NAME: SUCCESS STEP 2 TEXT
en.DESCRIPTION: Description of the second next step.

value.en: We prepare pricing and recommended services for your properties.

en.NAME: SUCCESS STEP 3 TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Title of the third next step, drawn with an envelope icon. Leave both step 3 parameters empty to omit the step.

en.NAME: SUCCESS STEP 3 TEXT
en.DESCRIPTION: Description of the third next step.

value.en: We’ll email you when your quote is ready to review.

en.NAME: SUCCESS BACK LABEL
en.DESCRIPTION: Label of the primary button on the success screen that leads to FORM_WEBSITE_URL. The button is shown only while FORM_WEBSITE_URL holds an http or https address.

en.NAME: SUCCESS AGAIN LABEL
en.DESCRIPTION: Label of a button on the success screen that clears the form for another submission. Leave empty to show no button, which is right whenever a second submission from the same visitor would create duplicate records.
